description:
Virtual Reality Survival Game "Merciless"

Somewhere, cameras are rolling,
and those who put their faces on a broadcast for money are forced to either kill or be killed. Standing at a crossroads of choice.

"It feels uncomfortably real, like I've actually killed someone..."

A brutal world where everyone must kill each other.
A person who had been living an ordinary life...
